post.author: Andreas Heine
post.topic_summary: i3x2ua v1.0.0 release: Python/FastAPI bridge from OPC-UA to i3X, now passing the i3X 1.0 conformance baseline for all MUST behaviors.

comment_posted.comment_text: The conformance pass on the i3X MUST behaviors is a meaningful checkpoint. One thing this highlights: the semantic richness i3X can expose is bounded by what arrives at the OPC-UA layer above the hardware. For equipment that does not speak native OPC-UA -- legacy PLCs, older CNCs, non-Profinet field devices -- the translation step that feeds i3x2ua is still solved piecemeal on each deployment, usually custom drivers or OPC-DA bridges. The i3X spec work and the upstream connectivity problem are on different timelines, and the slower one determines when a plant actually sees the benefit.
